problems: versions 1 and 3 share too many objects: keep only the most iconic

sensitive.name: Bugle
sensitive.why: A military signal horn strongly tied to war and to funeral/memorial use (Taps), so it can evoke death and loss for some players.

sensitive.name: Snare Drum
sensitive.why: Strongly associated with military marching and battle, so it carries war and militarism connotations in a set called War.
